identity.title: Your cryptographic identity
identity.explainer: This site generates a digital signing key for you that lives only in your browser. The server never holds a copy. Once it is set up, every meaningful action you take (vote, approve, join) is signed by you - and even we cannot forge it.

income.title: What I have earned here
income.sub: Everything that reached you through your rikmas — month by month.
income.loadFailed: We could not load your income data right now. Try refreshing in a moment.
income.emptyTitle: No money has arrived yet — and that is fine.
income.emptyBody: A first rikma almost never pays in its first month, and that is exactly what separates this track from a salary. The moment a split is confirmed, it shows up here.
income.chartSub: From {{from}} to {{to}}. Each colour is a different rikma.
income.chartAria: Chart of your monthly income by rikma. Total:
income.concurrent: There was a month when {{count}} rikmas paid you at the same time.
income.afterWork: {{percent}}% of your income arrived more than a month after the last time you worked in that rikma.
income.afterWorkNote: This is the part that keeps arriving when you are not working — the fruit of what you already built.
income.pending: {{amount}} across {{count}} transfers reported but not yet confirmed. They are not counted in the figures above.
income.hours: Alongside this you logged {{hours}} hours of work here.
income.method: Only confirmed splits are counted. The platform’s share of a split is not, and different currencies are never converted or added together.
